failures.title: Credentials committed to tracked .replit file
failures.detail: 13 sensitive credentials (API keys, DB passwords, SMTP password) stored in plaintext in .replit which is git-tracked. Exposure confirmed via git ls-files.
failures.remediation: See ROTATION_REQUIRED.md. Requires credential rotation + move to Replit Secrets. Cannot auto-fix without user action on external provider dashboards.

failures.title: creative_projects table missing tenant_id column
failures.detail: creative_projects has no tenant_id column. Access is scoped by projectId UUID (capability token). Full tenant row-level filtering is not possible without schema migration.
failures.remediation: Migration DDL documented in MIGRATION_RUNBOOK.md. Backfill strategy requires product input on ownership model for existing rows. Not auto-applied to production.

failures.title: 125 pre-existing TypeScript errors at baseline
failures.detail: 35 errors in production route/service files, 90 in test files. All pre-date this remediation branch. Critical path errors fixed in this branch (string | string[] narrowing, TS7030 customs, tenantId in graphic-design/service.ts).
failures.remediation: Critical path fixes applied. Remaining test file errors are pre-existing and do not affect runtime.

failures.title: Production dispatcher/scheduler startup not verified with dedicated tests
failures.detail: Dispatcher and scheduler have production env var guards (AI_DISPATCHER_ENABLED, AI_SCHEDULER_ENABLED) but lacked dedicated tests for prod-enabled, prod-missing, prod-invalid, duplicate startup, and shutdown scenarios.
failures.remediation: Added dispatcher.production.test.ts and scheduler.production.test.ts in services/__tests__/

failures.title: Signed URL revocations lost on process restart
failures.detail: signedUrlService.ts used an in-memory Set for revoked token IDs. Process restart cleared all revocations, restoring access for revoked tokens until they naturally expire.
failures.remediation: Added signedUrlRevocationStore.ts with ai_platform.signed_url_revocations DB table. signedUrlService.ts now persists revocations and loads them on startup.

failures.title: No SMTP configuration diagnostic endpoint
failures.detail: emailService.ts has isEmailConfigured() but no admin route exposed it. Operators had no way to verify SMTP config without reading logs.
failures.remediation: Added GET /api/ai/admin/smtp/diagnostic (admin-auth protected). Returns config status without exposing credentials.

paymentScopeExclusion: AUTOMATED PAYMENT GATEWAY EXCLUDED FROM SCOPE BY PRODUCT DECISION. No Midtrans, Xendit, Paylabs, or automated callback code added.
